purpose: E2E regression test that reproduces the KP-rotation-race bug (stale auto-invite uses old KeyPackage after sibling rotates on first group join) and gates the fix. The test fails on master HEAD without S1's freshness-collapse fix and passes once the fix is applied.

design_notes.slot_discipline: Two distinct slot strings ('sibling-fresh-1' and 'sibling-fresh-2') passed to authenticate() so each context publishes to a different KP d-tag. Omitting the slot would cause both contexts to derive the same slot from the bunker pubkey, collapsing them to one leaf and making the test pass for the wrong reason.
design_notes.primary_assertion: expect(page2.locator('aside').getByText(GROUP_B_NAME)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60_000 }) — sidebar visibility of Group B on the sibling page.
design_notes.belt_and_braces: Optional IDB failedCount === 0 check is present but is explicitly secondary to the sidebar assertion.
design_notes.relay_isolation: Group names embed Date.now() so each test run operates on distinct group names even if the ephemeral relay is not wiped between runs.
design_notes.skipMobile: propagated via beforeAll / workerInfo.project.use.isMobile per the forget-device-sibling.spec.ts reference pattern
design_notes.describe_serial: describe.serial enforces sequential step execution since each step depends on the outcome of the previous one
